name: Ikaw Na Sana
description: Ikaw na Sana was a Philippine drama series produced by Viva Television and distributed by GMA Network. This love story was later turned into a movie of the same title.

videos.title: Sacred Rituals
videos.overview: Throughout human history, diverse cultures have all used sacred rituals to express their spiritual beliefs. And while some ceremonial practices may appear strange, there are many rituals that are thought to unlock incredible powers. So, is it possible that performing certain acts can connect humanity to a higher plane of existence?
